sv.title: Italiensk aubergine lasagne
sv.description: Parmigiana i lager av grillad aubergine, hemgjord tomatsås med basilika, mozzarella och parmesan som gratineras i ugnen. Auberginen friteras inte. Låt vila en stund innan servering.

en.title: Italian Aubergine Lasagne
en.description: Parmigiana layered with griddled aubergine, homemade basil tomato sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan, then baked in the oven. The aubergine is not deep-fried. Leave it to rest before serving.
